clarity.notes: The lesson has one dominant question per step, explicit lock reasons, respectful retry copy, and a single successful exit outcome.

hierarchy.notes: The ruled editorial composition is specific to Learning AI, though the Settings live-preview and Access offer structures still read somewhat like familiar product patterns.

typography.notes: Avenir-led reading and display roles plus monospaced evidence labels are disciplined; quality still depends on locally available Avenir Next rather than a bundled font.

motion.notes: Motion is causal and learner-triggered, but live reduced-motion timing and focus continuity could not be browser-exercised in this run.

accessibility.notes: Native controls, focus-visible styling, 44px targets, skip navigation, live regions, forced-colors rules, and reduced-motion parity are encoded. Live keyboard traversal, assistive technology, and Windows High Contrast remain unproven.

brand.notes: The Decision Record, human-versus-AI evidence language, and restrained proof moments feel owned. The generic account form and some settings controls need future production context to become equally distinctive.

unproven: End-to-end keyboard focus order in a rendered browser
Production authentication, synchronization, payment, export, and cancellation flows
